reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic-assisted Terahertz ISAC. The carrier is THz (generated optically), not pure optical (FSO/VLC), hence classified as 'hybrid'. Waveform: LFM-PSK (Radar-centric) and LFM-QAM (Multi-channel). Approach: Uses photonic bandwidth to generate wideband THz signals for high resolution.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Metrics are exceptionally high: 120 Gbps (Comm) and 2.5 mm (Sensing) for the multi-channel setup. For the single channel LFM-PSK: 6 Gbps and 1.3 cm resolution. These are consistent with wideband THz capabilities. 20m link compensation is also mentioned.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Overcomes electronic bottlenecks in THz generation using photonics. 'Coherent Fusion' allows breaking the trade-off between rate and resolution. Gap: Hardware cost/complexity is high (requires frequency combs, optical modulators).
